direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh, overflow hidden at 1366x768; rows 48px header / 40px compact horizontal rail / minmax(0,1fr) main / 56px action bar; independent reserved zones for rendered scene, callouts, stations and jobs with no overlap; scene at least 70% of main; single non-wrapping horizontal rail of equal targets with aria-current and arrow-key movement; all targets at least 36px; condense side content inside its reserved zone without overlap
direction.colorTokens: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, border rgba(197,204,212,.22); brushed silver #C5CCD4 for headings and machine bodies, dim silver rgba(197,204,212,.68); emerald/neon #A8F04A primary with #050705 text, one primary per viewport; stoppedRed #E5484D only for stopped CELL-MILL-2 outline, cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text; official logo immutable in black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect in exactly two placements: header and opening story
direction.typography: System sans; 16px/24 body minimum, 24/30 stage title, 18/24 panel title, 12/16 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration; no label under 12px
direction.motion: 160-220ms ease-out for selection and panels; one 240ms route trace on real state change then static; no loops or pulses; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions while pattern, marker and text carry meaning; 2px neon focus ring with 2px offset; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; opening story carries the second and final logo placement; compact horizontal rail from one steps array; focusable cinematic factory SVG as dominant scene; side zone keeps pre-flight route-health checks for nonce and identity separate from the investigation evidence task under separate headings, status and controls; action bar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form; tab order skip-to-stage, header, rail, SVG nodes, side zone, action bar; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite for results
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 SVG enlarged to fill at least 70% of main using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in neon, silver idle machines, red only for stopped CELL-MILL-2, no route through the offline cell; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap inside stage bounds; bidirectional SVG-to-side-zone highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline-Stopped/Feasible-Accepted legend with pattern, marker and text; pending task proposals deliberately untracked until human approval, blocked prior tasks visible beside the approved recovery plan while replacement tasks await approval

fixes.change: Enlarge the factory SVG to at least 70% of main and shrink the empty gaps around CELL-MILL-2 and JOB-1002 so stations, jobs and routes read as one scene.
Remove the small logo inside the scene panel; keep only the required header placement on this step and reserve the second placement for the opening story.
Raise side-zone body and Source detail text to 16px/24 and give each evidence row a visible focus ring with bidirectional highlight to the Certificate and Receiving tracks.
Enlarge the factory SVG toward 70% of main; the central dark void weakens the cinematic scene despite clear discrepancy tracks.
Keep Route health pre-flight, with nonce pending and identity pending, visually and operably separate from the Investigation source-evidence panel below it, each with its own status and control.
Make the pending pre-flight status 16px and add aria-live polite so Check selected route and Run Spark Open results are announced without conflating the two controls.
Enlarge the scene to at least 70% of main and tighten the empty centre so the three recovery options at the bottom align with the tradeoff cards in the side zone.
Show selected state on a recovery option card in both zones before the primary activates, and confirm selecting it opens the typed consent form.
Increase the small Select this path label and Human decision status to 16px minimum body size where space allows, keeping micro-labels at 12px only.
Refit the left board so the proposed t1-t3 cards, station capacity and numbered markers occupy the scene zone without the large empty band above the stations.
Reduce duplication between the left proposal cards and the right proposal detail; make bidirectional highlighting link t1-t3 across zones instead of repeating full text.
Clarify in 16px that the 3 proposed tasks remain untracked until approval, while keeping Approve and Decline as the only approval controls in their reserved zone.
Preserve the strong neon feasible routes and preview cross-hatch, but label the preview state as PREVIEW 0h in the legend so pattern plus text carries meaning under reduced motion.
Ensure no preview route draws through CELL-MILL-2 once applied, and add a focus ring to the Machine to take offline selector with Esc restoring the prior preview.
Raise the small scenario-management link to a 36px target at 16px text so it is keyboard reachable without crowding the side zone.
Keep stoppedRed only on CELL-MILL-2 outline, cross-hatch and OFFLINE text; remove the broad red fill wash so the exception stays legible against the emerald and silver palette.
Enlarge the SVG scene to at least 70% of main and reconnect only feasible routes through CELL-MILL-1, with no route through the offline cell.
Separate the nonce and identity pre-flight pending states from the not-run investigation evidence status with clearer 16px status lines and independent focus order.
Preserve the constrained Split card cross-hatch and explanation, but raise its FINISH and INCREMENTAL placeholder labels to readable silver contrast.
Link each side-zone path card to its bottom scene card with bidirectional highlighting and a visible selected marker before the typed consent form opens.
Enlarge the central scene void into the SVG so JOB-1002 remains spatially tied to CELL-MILL-1 after CELL-MILL-2 stops.
Keep the 3 blocked prior tasks visibly separate from the 3 proposed replacements, and state in 16px that the approved revised plan coexists while replacements await approval.
Apply stoppedRed only to the CELL-MILL-2 station outline and OFFLINE replan text in the scene, not to surrounding panels.
Reduce repeated t1 detail across zones; use numbered markers 1-3 with bidirectional highlight and one full detail card in the side zone.
Make the three stage cards fill the scene zone more fully; the tall empty cards at 01-03 underuse the at-least-70% scene area.
Raise the side-zone instructional text, passphrase hint and waiting states to 16px/24, keeping only headings and step markers as micro-labels.
Add clear disabled styling with text reasons on Seal and Retain controls, plus a 2px focus ring on Verify ledger as the single primary action.

Preserve the sealed three-card completion state, but remove the neon outline around the hash-chain status line if it reads as an extra interactive control; reserve neon emphasis for the Complete rail state and status bar.
Give the Complete rail item aria-current and ensure Back plus the side-zone export control retain visible focus rings in tab order.
Keep final metrics 70, 35h and 48h at 26px tabular size and confirm the action-bar sealed summary fits one line at 1366x768 without truncation.
